ED Raids Premises Linked to TMC MP Nadimul Haque

The Enforcement Directorate (ED) conducted raids on multiple premises linked to Trinamool Congress (TMC) Rajya Sabha MP Mohammad Nadimul Haque. The searches, which began early morning, covered locations in Delhi, Kolkata, and Ranchi. The raids are reportedly connected to allegations of money laundering and funding operations under the guise of an Urdu newspaper. The ED searched at least seven to eight locations associated with the MP and his newspaper.
